sanskrit: oṃ namaś cidbhairavāya | citibhūtiṃ śrayata mā mudhā bhramata
l1:
## bhair-p01-v01 (1)
oṃ / obeisance / to-Consciousness-Bhairava / consciousness-ground-shelter-takers / consciousness-state / take / not / in-vain / wander / proclaiming / thus / of-devotees / conquers / Śiva / grace-bent // bhair-p01
l2: Oṃ. Obeisance to Consciousness-Bhairava. You who shelter in consciousness-ground: take consciousness-state, wander not in vain. Proclaiming thus — Śiva, bent on grace, conquers for devotees.
l3:
Oṃ — bow to Consciousness-Bhairava.
Shelter-takers, take knowing's state, never wander vain — grace-bent Śiva conquers.

sanskrit: cidbhairavam eva paraṃ paramāmṛtarūpam | ekam atidīptam
l1:
## bhair-p01-v02 (2)
Consciousness-Bhairava / alone / supreme / supreme-nectar-formed / one / high-blazing / having-swallowed-all-by-ring-of-shining-faculties / Śiva / I-venerate // bhair-p01
l2: Consciousness-Bhairava alone — supreme, supreme-nectar-formed, one, high-blazing. All swallowed by the ring of shining faculties — Śiva I venerate.
l3:
Consciousness-Bhairava alone — supreme, nectar-formed supreme, one, ablaze;
all swallowed in shining senses' ring — Śiva I praise.

sanskrit: stutyaḥ stotā stutir iti yad api vibhinnaṃ | mṛṣati yathā yad rūpaṃ cidrūpatayā
l1:
## bhair-p01-v03 (3)
praised-one / praiser / praise / thus / which / though / distinct / not / anything / is-here / endures / just-as / whatever / form / by-consciousness-form / so / becomes / this // bhair-p01
l2: Praised, praiser, praise — though distinct, nothing is here. It endures: as whatever form, by consciousness-form, so becomes this.
l3:
Praised, praiser, praise — though three, nothing here apart;
it holds: whatever shape, by knowing-shape, so this becomes.

sanskrit: vigalitasarvavibhedaṃ sarvavibhedātma cidghanānandam | tasyānukṛtiṃ tvadākṛtiṃ vande
l1:
## bhair-p01-v04 (4)
having-melted-all-distinctions / all-distinction-self / consciousness-mass-bliss / which / your / principle / O-Lord / imitation-of-it / your-form / I-venerate // bhair-p01
l2: All-distinctions-melted, all-distinction-self, consciousness-mass-bliss — which Your principle, Lord — its imitation, Your form — I venerate.
l3:
Distinctions melted, distinction-self, bliss-mass of knowing —
which Your truth, Lord — its likeness, Your shape — I venerate.

sanskrit: rekhāpuruṣaḥ puruṣaṃ varṇalipir varṇasaṃcayaṃ yadvat | tadvat vicitrarūpaṃ tvām ākāro vyanakti paramātman

l2: Outline-man, man, letter-script, letter-mass — just as, just so, of varied form, You — shape reveals, supreme self.
l3:
As outline-man shows man, script shows mass —
so varied-You, shape reveals, supreme self.

sanskrit: tatrāvikalpam eva tvāṃ cidrūpaṃ samāviśya | vimṛśāmaḥ kim api manāṅ na hi tattvaṃ kalpanāviṣayaḥ

## bhair-p01-v06 (6)
there / without-concepts-indeed / indeed / you / consciousness-formed / having-entered / we-reflect / what / even / a-bit / not / indeed / principle / fancy's-object // bhair-p01
l2: There concept-free indeed — You consciousness-formed entered — we reflect: what even a bit? Not indeed principle fancy's-object.
l3:
There, concept-free — entered You, knowing-formed —
we mirror: what, though a jot? Never fancy's catch, the true.

sanskrit: svātmaprabhāṃ vidhāya vāgdevīṃ | prathamonmeṣaṃ gurum atha vanditvā hṛdayam āviśya
l1:

l2: Own-light made, speech-goddess, sense-flowers-offering-arranged — first-unfolding guru, then venerated, heart entered.
l3:
Own light made, Word-goddess worded, sense-flowers laid —
first-unfolding guru, then honoured — heart entered.

sanskrit: staumi vimṛśan maheśvaram ātmānaṃ svaṃ cidekaghanam | srāvitapāśakadambakam etasmin dehadevagṛhe

l2: I praise, reflecting, the Great Lord — self, own, consciousness-one-mass. Poured-out-bond-cluster — in this body-god-house.
l3:
I praise, mirroring — great Lord, self, own, one-massed knowing —
bonds poured out in clusters — here, in the body, God's house.

sanskrit: cityānandecchāvitkaraṇākhyāḥ śaktayo jayanti | sūkṣmasthūlabhidāptā vaktratvaṃ brahmamuṇḍabhidhā

l2: Consciousness-bliss-will-cognition-action-named powers conquer, O Lord. Having got subtle-gross splits — mouth-hood, Brahma-skull-named.
l3:
Consciousness-bliss-will-lore-doing-named — powers conquer, Lord;
subtle-gross splits gained — mouths, Brahma-skull called.

sanskrit: sarvajñatādiviṣayaṃ hṛdayādikam aṅgaṣaṭkaṃ te | sakalaṃ sadāśivāntaṃ pretātmatayā tavāsanaṃ svāmin

l2: Omniscience-objected, heart and the rest, six-limbed — Yours. All up to Sadāśiva — by corpse-self — Your seat, O Lord.
l3:
All-knowing-aimed, heart-led, six-limbed — Yours;
all to Sadāśiva — corpse-selfed — Your seat, Lord.

sanskrit: paramaprakāśavapuṣo vimarśaśaktiḥ prabho parā devī | asyā eva prasaraḥ sarvā brāhmyādikā devyaḥ

l2: Of supreme-light-bodied, reflection-power, O Lord — supreme goddess. Hers indeed spread — all Brahmī-led goddesses.
l3:
Supreme-light-bodied — thought-power, Lord — goddess supreme;
hers indeed the spreading — all goddesses, Brahmī-led.

sanskrit: dahanajalāmṛtalekhāviṣādi bibhrat tvam ādiśasy etat | viśvaṃ viruddham api saccidrūpe mayi virudhyate naitat

l2: Fire-water-nectar-streak-poison-bearing, You point this. World opposed though — in true-consciousness-formed, in me unopposed — not this.
l3:
Fire, water, nectar-streak, poison — bearing, You show this;
world opposed though — in true-knowing-formed, in me unopposed — not this.

sanskrit: saṃvitsūtranilīno niḥsāro mātṛnivaho 'yam | karaṇamuṇḍamālabhārin darśayasītīva naḥ svāmin

l2: Knowing-thread-dissolved, sapless knower-host, this — skull-garland-of-faculties-bearing, You show thus, as-if, to us, O Lord.
l3:
Knowing-thread loosed, sapless knower-crowd —
sense-skull-garlanded You show — as it were — to us, Lord.

sanskrit: paśyata paśyata pāśā viṣamās ta ime bahiṣkṛtāḥ śaśvat | antradhāraṇamiṣat kathayaṃs tvaṃ naḥ samābhāsi

l3:
Look, look — hostile nooses — those, these, outcast ever;
gut-holding as it were, speaking — appear to us.

sanskrit: māyāpaṭaḥ sarāgo vyomni pare 'smin sa eṣa nikṣiptaḥ | gajacarma saraktaṃ mūrdhni vahan kathayasīśa

l3:
Māyā-cloth, impassioned, in highest heaven — there cast — that, this;
elephant-hide, bloodied, head-borne — You tell, Lord.

l3:
Inward-power dagger bared — world-round splitting — by sword;
world by own power-glory taken — best heroes indeed.

l3:
World-fear slayer — he, I, lorded, standing — am. Fear not.
So shield-clash shown — point us, Lord.

l3:
Self-power-noosed, by knowing-body, I count time;
so by noose-holding show us death's death — You.

sanskrit: bhedamayam akhilam etan nijaśaktyaivākṣipāmi saṃhartum | aṅkuśadhāraṇataḥ sphuṭayati parabhairavo 'smākam

l3:
Difference-made, all, this — by own power I hurl to unmake;
so goad-held makes plain — supreme Bhairava, to us.

l3:
By the boon hand, glory-giving enacted;
principle-fixed — by glory-stains untouched ever.

By fearlessness, world-fears uprooted, shown always;

Fameless-formed, unmatched — Māyā's shattered skull —
there, by supreme waking borne — thus You show.

Essence wholly taken — in me, alone, the world's rest,
in knowing's single mass. By skull-staff-bone pretext — command.

Lute, bell, drum — wild One, playing — this You show;
triple-split work-sound hearing, standing am I.

Parā-led triple-spoked power, lovely and great —

Will-led powers shown in lower seats three —
own supreme power, thunder-made — borne, six-spoked — You.

World entire by my power tamed, all stations held —

Mace, axe borne — bindu-nāda-mirrored —

skull-cup-blood-pretext shown — this, as it were, my inside.

## bhair-p04-v38 (38)
O-god / sky-cladness / your / says / uncovered / of-self / form / suns-of-supreme-Brahma-fullness / Māyā-covering / how / would-cover // bhair-p04
l2: O god — sky-cladness Yours says uncovered of self form — suns-of-supreme-Brahma-fullness — Māyā-covering — how would-cover?
l3:
God — Your sky-cladness speaks the self bare —
suns of supreme-Brahma-fullness — Māyā's veil — how should it cover?

## bhair-p04-v39 (39)
destroyer / of-all / suns-etc. / I / darkness-ground / by-spotless-autumn-sky-gleaming / by-body / thus / you-show // bhair-p04
l2: Destroyer of all, suns and the rest — I, darkness-ground — by spotless-autumn-sky-gleaming body — thus shown.
l3:
All-destroyer — suns and the rest — I, dark ground —
spotless autumn-sky gleaming-bodied — thus shown.

## bhair-p04-v40 (40)

l2: Supreme-Brahma-full You, god — when taking Bhairava-form — that shown knower-of-principle — being though in difference freed — thus.
l3:
Brahma-full supreme — god, when wearing Bhairava-shape —
that shown — principle-knower — being, though parted, freed.

## bhair-p05-v41 (41)
much-cremation-garland-ghoul-girt / you-show / sense-field-measuring-midst / Consciousness-Bhairava / am / thus // bhair-p05
l2: Much-cremation-garland-ghoul-girt, shown sense-field-measuring-midst — Consciousness-Bhairava am I — thus.
l3:
Girt with burning-ground garlands, ghouls around — measuring sense-fields' midst shown —
Consciousness-Bhairava am I.

## bhair-p05-v42 (42)
in-you / alone / nectar-streak / supreme-power-made / ultimate-knower / hence / O-Lord / you / indeed / of-worlds / life / thus / you-shine / our / in-heart // bhair-p05
l2: In You alone nectar-streak, supreme-power-made, ultimate-knower — hence Lord — You indeed worlds' life — thus shine our in-heart.
l3:
In You alone — nectar-streak, supreme-power-made, last knower —
hence Lord — You alone worlds' life — shine in our hearts.

## bhair-p05-v43 (43)
your / sound-mass-bodied / eightfold-ward / just / outer-retinue / by-supreme-subtle-etc.-splits / O-Bhairava / world-lord-led // bhair-p05
l2: Yours sound-mass-bodied eightfold-ward just outer-retinue — by supreme-subtle-splits, Bhairava, world-lord-led.
l3:
Yours — sound-mass-bodied, eightfold-warded — outer circle just;
by finest splits and finer, Bhairava, world-lords-led.

## bhair-p05-v44 (44)
seals / all / this / by-total-own-form-transmission / delights / devotee-throng / path-joy / by-fullness-showing // bhair-p05
l2: Seals all this by total-own-form-transmission — delights devotee-throng, path-joy, by fullness-showing.
l3:
It seals all this — total self-form given over —
gladdens the devotee-throng, path-joyed, by showing full.

## bhair-p05-v45 (45)

l2: Looses noose-net, melts distinction — O Lord, Your form seals much-consciousness-wealth — seal hence called.
l3:
Loosed noose-nets, melted marks — Your shape, Lord, seals
knowing-wealth of every kind — seal so called.

## bhair-p05-v46 (46)
conquers / in-supreme-principle-ground-excellent / draught-become-this / clearly / may-it-dwell / by-true-principle-showing / of-heart / known-stain // bhair-p05
l2: Conquers in supreme-principle-ground-excellent — draught-become-this — clearly may it dwell — by true-principle-showing, of heart known-stain.
l3:
It conquers — supreme-ground-excellent — draught-become —
clearly may it dwell — by truth-showing, heart's known-stain.

## bhair-p05-v47 (47)
momently / rises / consciousness / which / indeed / there / flashes / below / world / Śiva-Śakti-glory-formed / know / O-Maheśa / rite-standers // bhair-p05
l2: Momently rises consciousness — which indeed there flashes below — world Śiva-Śakti-glory-formed know, Maheśa, rite-standers.
l3:
Each moment rises knowing — there indeed it flashes, below —
world Śiva-power-glory-formed — know it, Maheśa's rite-standers.

## bhair-p05-v48 (48)
thus / you-flash / always / in-me / O-Consciousness-Bhairava / all-beings-self / then / rite-to-mantra-end / accomplished / effortlessly / all // bhair-p05
l2: Thus You flash always in me — Consciousness-Bhairava, all-beings-self — then rite-to-mantra-end accomplished effortlessly — all.
l3:
So in me You flash, always — Consciousness-Bhairava, every being's self —
then rite to mantra's end, complete — effortless, all.
